description: This PHP source file defines a class 'smpl_Invoice_Group_Sample' which appears to generate a PDF invoice template. It includes methods to retrieve invoice type, generate the body of the PDF with HTML content, header, and footer. The class uses external services and translation functions to populate dynamic content in the invoice.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Group_Sample
classes.description: Class responsible for generating a PDF invoice sample with dynamic content and formatting.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'AOS_Invoices', indicating the type of document.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the invoice PDF, including tables, images, and translated labels.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string as header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the footer of the PDF, including page number and date.
